ARTICLE 47

TERMINATION

This Agreement shall be effective July 1, 2003 except where specifically provided that a particular provision will be effective on another date and shall continue in full force and effect up to and including June 30, 2007. It shall automatically be renewed from year to year thereafter unless either party shall notify the other in writing by such time as would permit the parties to comply with the collective bargaining schedule established under the Public Employee Relations Act.

The parties hereto through their duly authorized officers or representatives and intending to be legally bound, hereby have hereunto set their hands and seals on this 28th of May, 2004.

COMMONWEALTH OF PENNSYLVANIA
